decisions.reason: The product stays close to the firm's existing hosting and compliance know-how and the early agency-focused feedback is interpretable through its own R&D, so it is likely to learn and improve it rather than drop it.
It builds directly on the firm's established web hosting platform and in-house R&D, giving the firm the related knowledge to assimilate results and continue developing the platform.
As a configurable managed hosting plan close to the existing offer, it fits the firm's current technical and service capabilities, allowing the firm to interpret market responses and adjust the plan.
